published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Seal Fate Swords with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
rotation: The Combat Swords rotation with 4-point Eviscerates (no Adrenaline Rush talent, so that line is skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5s), or at 79+ energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. Its flask gives its full bonus only there.
10% hit (the wrist and the second ring carry 10 hit rating each): dual wielders take hit by sim (standards 4), and past the 8% yellow cap it still helps the white hits (+0.4 to +1.9 over 8%).
No Goblin Land Mine: its 1 sec cast resets the swing, so it loses DPS here. The Sapper stays.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__seal-fate-swords except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29) (follows its base build, rogue__seal-fate-swords), was Orc.
